notes: Copy this file to scope.json next to .env, or pass any path with ./run-audit.ps1 -Scope <file>.
Every list is optional. An empty list, or a missing key, means everything the app can read.
Subscriptions match by id or display name; environments by instance URL, environment id or display name.

types limits the per-resource readers (sql, synapse, keyvault, nsg, loganalytics, logicapps, storage, vm, appservice, automation, apiconnections); rbac, defender, diagnostics and the resource inventory always run per selected subscription.
resources pins names per reader; delete that block to audit whole resource groups.
Precedence: run-audit.ps1 parameters > this file > AZURE_SUBSCRIPTIONS and DATAVERSE_ENVIRONMENTS in .env.
A run with any selection is labelled PARTIAL in output/assessment-report.md; a selection the app cannot see reads Not checked (or stops the run with -StrictScope).
